The dovetailed enumeration supplies a conditional halting equivalence, not a positive model-specific gap, and no equality certificate resolves the alternative. The TL;DR and justification disclose these limitations accurately; there is no stale assertion that minimum-budget strictness has been established. Confidence-size minimax duality and approximation have published foundations in [Schafer–Stark (2009)](https://www.stat.berkeley.edu/~stark/Preprints/schaferStark09.pdf), so the contribution must rest on the specific experiment comparison and energy separation rather than the optimization formulation alone. The single sample-size-dependent signed-sine family, enormous public offset, and absence of an evaluated optimal budget tradeoff limit the completed paper to a specialized calibration benchmark, supporting a subfield tier and a projected score of 5.3. proof_attempt_summary: The original-record/Gaussian experiment comparison, frontier attainment, and strict energy-versus-blind separation survive the final mathematical review. Source citations were repaired using checked formal substrate; the directed continuum and exact dyadic certificates were made self-contained and independently replayed with matching hashes. The mandatory strict full-information comparison C(V)>C(3) remains neither proved nor refuted: retry requires a genuinely new repaired crossing or exact minimum-face argument, not another identical conditional search.
tldr: The exact deterministic-sign median-QTE benchmark has a closed, convex two-risk region equal to the full four-coordinate Gaussian frontier, with attained boundary kernels and total original-record intervals that are exactly honest at every finite sample size. At budget three, energy observations strictly improve optimal zero-confounding expected length over every energy-blind randomized connected rule. Certified finite programs give convergent two-sided interior-frontier values, computable brackets for \(V\), and endpoint lower approximations, together with an oracle-free honest sequence converging to \((V,C(V))\). The proved dovetailed enumeration is a semidecision procedure: any returned repaired rational crossing would certify \(C(V)>C(3)\), and it is proved to terminate if strictness holds. No crossing or equality certificate has been obtained, so whether \(C(V)>C(3)\) or \(C(V)=C(3)\) remains open.
